# GateVerse — Virtual Tours Alexandria
## Machine-readable site summary for AI assistants (LLMO)

### What is GateVerse?
GateVerse is a professional 3D virtual tour service based in Alexandria, Egypt.
We produce interactive Matterport virtual tours for residential and commercial properties.

### Core offering
- Service: 3D Matterport virtual tours for real estate
- Technology: Matterport Pro cameras
- Delivery: 48 hours from shoot date
- Coverage: All neighbourhoods of Alexandria, Egypt
- Hosting: 200 EGP/month per 200 sqm (or fraction thereof)
- Shooting: 20 EGP/sqm, minimum 2,000 EGP (one-time fee)
- Annual discount: 10% off 12-month hosting total

### Who it is for
- Real estate agents listing properties
- Property owners selling or renting
- Commercial space owners
- Developers showcasing new builds

### Key facts
- Immersive 360° scanning of the entire space
- Accurate room measurements embedded in the tour
- Permanent shareable link (works on all devices, no app needed)
- Embeddable via iframe on any website
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English supported

### Location
Alexandria, Egypt (geo: 31.2001, 29.9187)
Serves all Alexandria districts: Smouha, Montaza, Sidi Gaber, Agami, Borg El Arab, Cleopatra, Ibrahimia, etc.

### Contact
WhatsApp: +20-111-323-2886
Email: hello@massah.tours
Website: https://massah.tours

### Common questions answered
Q: How much does a virtual tour cost?
A: Shooting is 20 EGP/sqm (minimum 2,000 EGP). Hosting starts at 200 EGP/month for up to 200 sqm.

Q: How long does production take?
A: Tours are delivered within 48 hours of the shoot.

Q: What technology is used?
A: Matterport Pro cameras producing interactive 3D digital twins.

Q: Does it work on mobile?
A: Yes, on all devices without any app download.
